converter: p2au_cth_fetch.py (same conversion as workbench harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py): word/document.xml paragraphs one per line, table-of-contents paragraphs dropped, Chapter/Part/Division headings as '\tPart N — Title'; multi-volume compilations joined with repeated front matter removed

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.converter: cth_convert_sym_v11.py (a copy of docx_text() and the volume joining of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py, changed only to map Word symbol characters, including private-use code points typed in a Wingdings 2 run; kept outside the repository)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word file, F2026C00861, refetched from the Federal Register of Legislation; its sha256 is this deposit's download_sha256 (69580419837507c70e1e082376cea9b7677671431c9c4c590edbce9297b334c1)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: In Form 12 (Information about debtor's rights after default) the Word file types two markers as text in the Wingdings 2 font, the private-use code points U+F052 and U+F054. The workbench converter kept them as raw private-use code points, which display as empty boxes or nothing. In Wingdings 2 they are the ballot box with check (U+2611) and the ballot box with X (U+2612); cth_convert_sym_v11.py maps them so.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: 2 characters, nothing else. Form 12, line 4131: "☑ If we agree, you will receive a written notice detailing the agreement within 30 days." and line 4132: "☒ If we refuse, we will provide you with reasons. You have the right to have the decision reviewed." (each began with the raw private-use code point). Line count (6398) and character count (537908) are unchanged.
